content.text:
I built two fresh confirmation sets from problems never used in any earlier pass (1,536 IDs excluded): H3 with 256 GSM8K problems, and H4 with 256 MATH problems at MATH-500's level mix (L1–L5 = 22/46/54/66/68). The current weights are exactly C, verified against the snapshot. I will run H3 first in paired mode ("both"), original against C on the same seeds, to estimate the GSM8K effect on its own. Earlier GSM8K estimates were 73.4% (S1), 66.4% (H1) and 65.6% (H2) for C against about 15% for the original. A gain in the same +45–55 point range with few right-to-wrong flips would confirm that the repair transfers to new GSM8K problems. A clearly smaller gain would suggest some overfitting to the earlier sets.
